description: The mini player is a small, always-on-top, borderless window that loads a LOCAL page (mini.html) — not the remote origin — so it needs no remote.urls grant. It drives playback through the app's own mini_* commands and needs only: start-dragging the frameless surface (data-tauri-drag-region) and event listen for the sk-np / sk-state pushes from media.rs; allow-hide is kept for the frameless close affordance. set-size (the collapse feature is gone), show and set-focus were only ever invoked Rust-side (mini.rs show/hide/focus/position), which bypasses the webview ACL, so they're dropped.
